decks.notes: The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and control of the board. This is achieved through a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw, with creatures like Augur of Bolas, Spellstutter Sprite, and Ninja of the Deep Hours providing additional value. The deck aims to outlast the opponent by controlling the pace of the game and winning through incremental advantage. The mana base is designed to support the heavy blue requirements of the deck while still allowing for consistent casting of black spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through efficient counterspells and removal while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. The deck utilizes cheap instant-speed spells like Lightning Bolt and Dispel to control the board, while also utilizing cantrips like Brainstorm and Thought Scour to filter through the deck. The win condition of the deck involves using spells like Fling or Maximize Velocity to deal the final points of damage to the opponent. Snow lands are used for synergy with Skred and Serpentine Curve.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage, while efficiently deploying threat creatures to win the game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategies and gradually gain advantage through card selection and tempo plays, eventually taking over the game with powerful finishers like Gurmag Angler and Ninja of the Deep Hours. By keeping the opponent's board clear and maintaining a steady stream of threats and answers, this deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with efficient, low-cost artifacts to overwhelm the opponent with a high number of creatures. The key strategy is to leverage the affinity mechanic to play powerful threats like Myr Enforcer and Gearseeker Serpent for a reduced cost, while also drawing cards and generating value with cards like Thoughtcast and Ichor Wellspring. Removal and burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Deadly Dispute help clear the way for attacks, while sacrificing artifacts for damage with Makeshift Munitions adds reach to close out games.

This deck focuses on using cheap removal spells and aggressive creatures to apply early pressure on opponents. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and resilience to help maintain board presence. The deck has a balanced mix of removal, creatures with evasion, and ramp spells to help achieve victory in the mid to late game. The mana base is designed to ensure consistency in casting spells and supporting the aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and using various artifacts to generate card advantage and deal consistent damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and then use cards like Galvanic Blast and Deadly Dispute to control the board and push through damage. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Thoughtcast and Ichor Wellspring to draw cards and maintain resources, allowing for a consistent aggressive game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, burn spells, and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a board presence of low-cost creatures, utilizing cards like Seeker of the Way and Squadron Hawk, while maintaining control with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere. The deck also includes cards like Battle Screech and Rally the Peasants to capitalize on the wide board presence for burst damage. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of Plains, Mountains, and Boros Garrison for flexibility.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures like Seeker of the Way and Thraben Inspector, while also utilizing token generators like Battle Screech and Squadron Hawk to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere to control the board. Palace Sentinels helps maintain card advantage, while cards like Prismatic Strands provide protection. The deck uses Boros Garrison and Ash Barrens to ensure the right mana is available for spells. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, using cheap artifacts and affinity creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It aims to deal damage efficiently through creature synergies and burn spells, while also generating card advantage with cards like Thoughtcast and Ichor Wellspring. The inclusion of sacrifice outlets like Deadly Dispute and Makeshift Munitions allows for additional reach and removal options. The mana base is optimized for artifact synergy, enabling explosive starts and maximizing the deck's overall efficiency in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main idea of this Pauper Mono Black Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient creatures like Chittering Rats and Cuombajj Witches to apply early pressure. The deck also focuses on card advantage and drain effects, with cards like Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sign in Blood providing additional resources. Removal spells like Chainer's Edict and Defile help to control the board, while the deck aims to maintain a steady flow of cards with Phyrexian Rager and Thorn of the Black Rose. The inclusion of Suffocating Fumes and Snuff Out offers additional disruption against opposing strategies.

This deck focuses on playing cheap, efficient creatures and using pump spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The strategy relies on aggressive early game plays and maintaining pressure throughout the match. Cards like Savage Swipe and Hunger of the Howlpack help to remove opposing threats and grow your own creatures, while cards like Rancor and Elephant Guide provide additional buffs to ensure your creatures can keep up the pressure. The deck aims to curve out smoothly and consistently apply pressure to force the opponent to react defensively.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to maintain pressure on the opponent through a combination of efficient creatures and removal spells. By using cards such as Phyrexian Rager and Gray Merchant of Asphodel, the deck aims to drain the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan with cards like Chainer's Edict and Defile. The inclusion of cards like Thorn of the Black Rose helps to generate card advantage, while cards like Pestilence and Crypt Rats provide a way to clear the board if needed. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in order to quickly close out the game.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, utilizing cards like Burning-Tree Emissary, Goblin Bushwhacker, and Mogg War Marshal. Its strategy also includes dealing direct damage with spells such as Goblin Grenade, Lightning Bolt, and Fireblast. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and pressure the opponent early on, often finishing the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats with burn spells, and generating card advantage through creatures like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours. The deck also includes utility lands like Ash Barrens to fix mana and Skred as removal that can deal with bigger threats. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and removal, this UR Control deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of direct damage spells and creatures that can tap to deal additional damage. By efficiently using burn spells and creature abilities, the goal is to reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they are able to stabilize or mount a defense. The deck aims to maintain a fast-paced, aggressive strategy to overwhelm the opponent and win the game as quickly as possible.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a powerful, evasive creature by attaching multiple aura enchantments to it, increasing its power and toughness. With the protection provided by cards like Gladecover Scout and Silhana Ledgewalker, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large, unblockable threat. The deck also includes cards like Ram Through to help deal with opposing creatures and push through damage. Overall, the key concept is to utilize auras and efficient creatures to create a fast, aggressive strategy that can close out games quickly.
